title: Zeptly QB registry: shared definitions

semverRange.description: npm-style semver range (^1.2.0, ~1.2, >=1.0.0 <2.0.0, 1.2.3). Grammar is verified semantically by the validator.

digest.$comment: PROVISIONAL: pending cross-registry reconciliation with registry-execution-agents, registry-tiny-agents and registry-skills. NOT YET CANONICAL. Common release/digest protocol.

id.$comment: PROVISIONAL: pending cross-registry reconciliation with registry-execution-agents, registry-tiny-agents and registry-skills. NOT YET CANONICAL. Cross-registry identifier syntax.

pinnedRef.description: Exact-version reference: <id>@<semver>. Used wherever a specific artifact is meant (provenance, evidence).

evidenceUri.description: Opaque pointer into an evidence store: evidence://<store>/<path>. Never a URL, never a filesystem path.

lifecycleStatus.$comment: PROVISIONAL: pending cross-registry reconciliation with registry-execution-agents, registry-tiny-agents and registry-skills. NOT YET CANONICAL. Lifecycle terminology.

$comment: PROVISIONAL: pending cross-registry reconciliation with registry-execution-agents, registry-tiny-agents and registry-skills. NOT YET CANONICAL. Applies to the ID/reference syntax (id, pinnedRef, qbPinnedRef, semverRange), the lifecycle status terms, the digest format and evidenceUri.
